statements.dolt: CREATE TABLE t(id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT, b INT, v VARCHAR(200))
statements.sql: CREATE TABLE t(id int PRIMARY KEY, a int, b int, v VARCHAR(200))

INSERT INTO t WITH RECURSIVE s(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM s WHERE n < 199)
  SELECT (x.n*200 + y.n)*10, (x.n*200 + y.n) % 1000, x.n*200 + y.n,
         CONCAT('row-', x.n*200 + y.n, '-', 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789abcdefghijklmnop')
  FROM s x, s y
UPDATE t SET a = a + 1 WHERE b % 97 = 0 AND b NOT BETWEEN 10000 AND 12999 AND b NOT BETWEEN 30000 AND 31499
DELETE FROM t WHERE b BETWEEN 10000 AND 12999
INSERT INTO t SELECT id + 5, a, b, CONCAT(v, '-gap') FROM t WHERE b % 151 = 3
UPDATE t SET v = CONCAT(v, '-f2') WHERE b % 173 = 7 AND b NOT BETWEEN 10000 AND 12999 AND b NOT BETWEEN 30000 AND 31499
UPDATE t SET b = b + 1000000 WHERE b % 97 = 0 AND b NOT BETWEEN 10000 AND 12999 AND b NOT BETWEEN 30000 AND 31499
DELETE FROM t WHERE b BETWEEN 30000 AND 31499

INSERT INTO t WITH RECURSIVE s(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM s WHERE n < 199)
  SELECT 1000000 + x.n*200 + y.n, 7, x.n*200 + y.n, CONCAT('tail-', x.n*200 + y.n)
  FROM s x, s y WHERE x.n < 5
SELECT CONCAT('R|agg|', count(*), '|', SUM(id), '|', SUM(a), '|', SUM(b), '|', SUM(LENGTH(v))) FROM t
SELECT CONCAT('R|index_range|', count(*), '|', SUM(id), '|', SUM(b)) FROM t WHERE a BETWEEN 100 AND 120
